name: Quick chat
description:
1. **Goal:** Design planning and follow-up views for codx-junior to complement the existing Kanban board, helping users and managers see progress and manage priorities.
2. **Initial proposal:** Two views — Planning (prioritized drag-and-drop task list with due dates/priority) and Follow-up (dashboard with metrics, overdue queue, board progress, and activity feed) — plus shared view-switcher tabs.
3. **Key adjustment:** Explored the codebase and found the project uses DaisyUI 5 + Tailwind 4 tokens (`base-100/200/300`, `base-content`, `primary`, semantic colors), not raw hex, so the design was realigned to the existing system.
4. **Deliverable shift:** Instead of coding, produced annotated wireframes, a design-token mapping, and a standalone clickable HTML mockup (using the codx theme) covering Board/Planning/Follow-up views.
5. **Review guidance:** Included anti-patterns, accessibility checklist, and offered next-step iterations (timeline/calendar variant, workload panel, or mobile breakpoint mockups).

Follow up with user's and agent's tasks.

codx-junior is a team platform where user's and AI agents perform tasks.
Both users and agents can create tasks and perform them. 
We already have a KanbanBoard view to manage tasks in a Trello fashion.

We need a planning and follow-up views that helps user's and project managers to see what's going on and manage priorities.

Help me finding designing the views and functionalities.
Instead coding, let's generate mockups to review these new views.

I'll explore the existing project to understand the design patterns, then create mockups for review. ``` Read 2 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardSidebar.vue, src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardCanvas.vue ``` ``` Read 6 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/kanban/TaskCard.vue, src/components/kanban/TaskCardLite.vue, src/components/kanban/Badge.vue, src/components/kanban/KanbanList.vue, src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardTaskRow.vue, src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardColumn.vue ``` ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` ``` Search completed: 5 queries executed, 50 documents found ``` I explored the existing kanban implementation and design system. Here's the key finding that changes my earlier recommendation: **your project uses DaisyUI 5 + Tailwind 4 theme tokens** (`base-100/200/300`, `base-content`, `primary`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `error`), *not* raw hex values. The mockups below are therefore built on your actual token system so they'll drop straight into the UI. Below you'll find: 1. Compact annotated wireframes (quick review in-chat) 2. ``` --- ## 4. Anti-Patterns to Avoid (design review notes) 1. **Don't duplicate priority/due-date semantics across views** — use the *same* `High/Med/Low` + `Overdue/Today` badges in Planning and Follow-up so users learn the language once. 2. **Don't make color the only signal** — every badge in the mockup pairs color with an icon + text label (e.g. `⚠ High`, not just a red dot). 3. **Don't cram planning metadata onto Kanban cards** — keep the board focused on *workflow state* (columns), and let Planning own *priority/due* to avoid visual noise. ## 5. Accessibility Checklist (for final implementation) - [ ] Drag reordering is keyboard-operable (arrow keys + Enter/Space to lift/drop) - [ ] Visible focus rings on all interactive elements (`focus-visible:ring`) - [ ] `progress` bars always accompanied by numeric text (`6/10 · 60%`) - [ ] Filter `` have associated labels/aria-labels - [ ] Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text; 3:1 for the large metric numerals - [ ] Activity feed and metric changes announced via `aria-live` --- ## How to review 1. Save the HTML above as `planning-followup.html` and open it in a browser. 2. Use the **Board / Planning / Follow-up** tabs in the top bar to switch. 3. In Planning, click any task row to see the right-hand detail panel state. 4. Review the Follow-up metrics, "Needs attention" queue, and board progress bars. Want me to iterate on any of these (e.g. switch Planning to a *timeline/calendar* variant, add a team **capacity/assignee workload** panel, or produce a mobile breakpoint mockup)?

- Both integrate with the existing Kanban board via a new top-level `WorkspaceView` tab navigation component.  
- Proposed extending the `Chat` data model with priority, due date, assignees, completion flag, and progress percentage, plus matching store methods.  
- Provided Vue 3 component code using TailwindCSS/DaisyUI, including `PlanningView`, `TaskPriorityList`, `TaskCard`, `FollowupView`, and `MetricsGrid`.  
- Included anti-patterns, accessibility checklist, and step-by-step implementation guidance for backend, store, and frontend rollout.
